title: China blocks Meta's $2B Manus acquisition, after reviewing whether it violated investment rules, and tells both to cancel it; Manus moved to Singapore in 2025 (Arjun Neil Alim/Financial Times)
summary: Arjun Neil Alim / Financial Times: China blocks Meta's $2B Manus acquisition, after reviewing whether it violated investment rules, and tells both to cancel it; Manus moved to Singapore in 2025 — Regulators had reviewed whether deal violated Beijing's investment rules — China has blocked Meta's $2bn acquisition …
contentText:
Arjun Neil Alim / Financial Times :

China blocks Meta's $2B Manus acquisition, after reviewing whether it violated investment rules, and tells both to cancel it; Manus moved to Singapore in 2025   —  Regulators had reviewed whether deal violated Beijing's investment rules  —  China has blocked Meta's $2bn acquisition …
